$comment: PROPOSAL, NOT LOADABLE YET. Same character as specs/halloween/spot.json, with the prose blob split into the fields specs/character.schema.json already publishes. cag/spec.py:65 currently rejects every field below except name, height, description, animations, detail_level and props, so this file will not load until that is changed. Chosen as the worked example because Spot is the case that breaks inference: he has no footwear at all, and the regex that pulls a costume anchor out of the generated bible returns nothing for him.
name: Spot
description: A big friendly werewolf who lives for the howling chorus of classic rock anthems; goofy, eager and loyal, more golden retriever than monster.
build: Broad-chested and shaggy with long arms, a deep chest tapering to a narrower waist, and digitigrade wolf legs. Stands upright and level like the rest of the roster, weight even over both feet.
face: A full wolf head with a long muzzle, tall pointed ears standing upright, one dark brown patch around the character-left eye, amber eyes, and a big open-mouthed friendly grin with the tongue just showing.
hair: A shaggy grey-brown coat with a lighter cream chest and muzzle, and a bushy tail. Fur, not human hair.
outfit: A red plaid flannel shirt with the sleeves ripped off at the shoulders and a few ragged tears across the back, worn open over the cream chest fur. Faded blue jeans torn off raggedly at mid-shin. A loose red bandana knotted around his neck. His large clawed wolf feet are bare — he wears no footwear of any kind. The claws are short and blunt.
personality: Goofy, eager and loyal. Reads as delighted to be on stage.
performance_style: Upright and eager: feet planted, chest open, ears up, tail raised in a happy curve, the free character-left hand relaxed at the side.
recognition_cues: full wolf head with a long muzzle
shaggy grey-brown coat with a lighter cream chest and muzzle
one dark brown patch around the character-left eye
a torn red plaid flannel shirt
avoid: human hair or a human face
bared fangs in a snarl, a threatening glare or raised hackles
a crouched, hunched, prowling or four-legged posture
a full moon or night backdrop
a shirt left intact or buttoned closed

animations.dance: Eager rock dance loop: bounce on the digitigrade legs through two happy side steps, let the tail wag and the ragged flannel flap, bob the head so the tall ears flop slightly, then bounce back into his upright eager stance.

sing.intent: Howling rock vocal loop: tip the long muzzle up toward the ceiling, throw back the head for a long joyful howl with the free fist pumping once, then settle back into his upright eager stance. The jaws must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the ears flatten back, the tail tucks and the shoulders hunch up for a beat like a surprised dog, then the ears pop back up and the tail lifts as he restores his upright eager stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and fold the free furry arm up in front of the muzzle, ears pressed back, then hold a steady upright finish. Not a combat action.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: bound in with springy upright strides, skid to a happy stop, give a quick full-body shake that ruffles the fur and flannel, then plant into the upright ready stance with the tail curled high.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: throw the free fist overhead, tail wagging hard, let out one short triumphant howl with the muzzle up, then hold a proud upright pose with a big tongue-out grin.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the enthusiasm drains out of him — the tall ears droop flat to the sides, the tail sinks low between the legs, and his head hangs with the muzzle pointed toward the floor in a hangdog sulk. He holds a standing, visibly dejected finish with weight even over both feet. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, lying down, dropping to all fours or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
